name: Mizuno Shizuka
source:
Shizuka should be the most responsible member of the Mizuno family, as [url=https://vndb.org/c38472]Yousuke[/url]'s kind step-mother and [url=https://vndb.org/c23240]Ryouko[/url]'s mother. However, despite her grief over her husband's death, she seems to be a bit more naturally carefree than her daughter. That hasn't, however, prevented her from becoming lonely. As a result, she encourages Yousuke to visit her often.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/565978-tsuki-possession/faqs/28692]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
